nom: DRMTLGY Microdermabrasion Scrub Gentle Physical Exfoliant

avis.titre: As a facial scrub used 2 times a week, this scrub helps to clean pores and remove dead skin cells
avis.texte: I am 71 years old, and have been using this face scrub/mask for about two weeks. First of all, I don't have any major skin problems. I have been using all natural products on my face for the last couple of years, and noticed a couple of what looks like blackheads at the side of my nose. Whether this was caused by the oils I use on my face or just an aging thing, I don't know. At any rate, I decided it was time to look for a facial scrub, and chose this one because of the natural ingredients. As a facial scrub, I love it. The granules are small and not like rocks and the substance they are in applies easily and fluidly. The directions on the container recommend applying and leaving on your face for 1-3 minutes. Since I don't have a lot of spare time and am always in a hurry, I have managed to leave it on for 1 minute and have used it 3 times per week. I have noticed that the little blackheads around my nose are disappearing, it rinses off easily, and my face feels so much cleaner feeling than it has with other cleansers I have tried. I do use rose water and a natural moisturizer afterwards, and have to say that my skin looks brighter and healthier. I have not yet tried this product as a facial mask that would require leaving it on for 15-20 minutes, but I will try this in the near future. If this works as a mask, it would be so much better than the thick grey stuff you need to smear on your face and let it dry until it cracks. At this point, I am very happy with the results wh

I am acne prone and this gave me terrible clogged pores and it’s taking weeks to clear them. Super annoying. It’s a lovely scrub and felt super good to use, but a handful of days in my skin started freaking out. The acne prone know what it’s like when a product is just not a fit.

avis.titre: Smooth face, low cost! Love it!Smooth face, low cost! Love it!
avis.texte: This dace scrub is great! I have oily skin with large pores. It is comparable to the Rodan and Fields microdermabration paste, although less oily, at a fraction of the cost. Leaves my skin feeling super smooth! I also really love the drmtlgy essential cleanser. I use that prior to this product, in the evening a few times a week. A tiny bit of product goes a long way!

avis.titre: Great value and great on skin.
avis.texte: I use this product once a day and it’s made my skin sooooo smooth. It’s easy to use, and my dead skin and blackheads have significantly reduced. I use about a dime size and lather it over my face to get the ugly stuff out. Love this product.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel so soft
avis.texte: I was surprised how much I love this scrub! It is gently, yet you can feel how the tiny particles are scrubbing your skin. It does not irritate your skin, instead it makes your skin so soft and glowy. I have sensitive skin and I have no adverse reaction to this product at all.

not too rough on your face but has enough power that is scrubs away dead skin cells. It has no scent and leaves your face radiant. It has a clay like consistency. I hate weak microdermabrasion abrasion scrubs that don’t really have anything in them that actually polishes your face but this is the winner.
I've only used it twice so far but I like the way my skin feels afterwards. It's a very fine exfoliate and didn't irritate my skin or leave it feeling dry. I would recommend it.
Just a tiny amount goes a long way. It makes my face feel nice and clean. The scrub is so fine . I use it usually 2 to 3 times a week for a nice deep clean.

This DRMTLGY Microdermabrasion Scrub has become a staple in my skincare routine. While the container appears small in size, the potency of this formula packs a punch. When used infrequently and sparingly, this scrub will brighten your complexion, soften lines, minimize pores, and provide consistent balance across your skin’s surface. I have only used this scrub about 3x since I purchased it (once per week), and have already noticed significant improvement with my skin. My goal was to reduce the appearance of my pores, and this scrub is doing exactly that. In terms of texture, this scrub has a thick consistency; however, it spreads evenly, allowing you to use minimal product. With that, this container could last a few months, especially with infrequent use. The scrub has essentially no odour, which is a must for sensitive skin. If used too often, this scrub could cause dryness, and perhaps even minor irritation. The formula is potent, but gentle enough to be suitable for those with sensitive skin.

I just recently finished this jar of exfoliating scrub cleanser. The main purpose I purchased this item was to help exfoliate dead skin cells that can clog up my pores and/or form milia, which I am prone to and I needed something to exfoliate without causing a reaction. This really helped a lot. I really liked how the consistency of the texture and how much I can really exfoliate without breaking or damaging the skin barrier of my face and it did not dry out my skin after each use. I have areas on my face that are very sensitive, so I react to a lot of exfoliate cleanser, but I have not once had a breakout or any side affect happen to me when I was using this exfoliating cleanser. It removed a lot of the dead skin cells, smoothed the texture of my skin from acne scars, minimize the amount of blackheads from forms and the size of my pores, while maintaining the moisture and hydration of the skin. Also, I love that you do not need to use a lot for the whole face as the product spreads very well, so this bottle has lasted me since last Oct 2024 . I also enjoyed that there isn't any scent to the cleanser, at least from my perspective. The few downsize I would say from this product is the packaging and how well the formula is, because I had to really wash my face well as I may sometimes find there would still be small amount of the exfoliation on my face and you do have to scoop out the product, but I did not mind it so much until I got to the last bit of the product and scraping

Very fine exfoliating particles, effective but gentle. Doubles as a scrub and a mask. Leaves skin noticeably smoother and brighter. Works well for most skin types. A small amount covers a lot of surface area. Not ideal for extremely sensitive or compromised skin. Premium price point, though the performance backs it up.
Love this ! Super fine grit to it and my face feels So clean
very fine texture, thick enough that you only have to use a very small amount. They DO NOT skimp on filling their containers, will be repurchasing this until I die. No strong smell

avis.titre: Best decision I could have made for my skin!
avis.texte: I was searching for an exfoliant that would remove the patches of dead skin on my cheeks and nose, as winters in Oregon are harsh and dry my skin out. I am SO HAPPY I decided to purchase this scrub! It is gentle, and extremly effective! My skin hasn’t been this soft and clear in years! Not only has it buffed away the dead skin patches on my face, but it has also worked wonders for color correction! I had some minor acne dark marks and patches of discoloration, and my face is now all one even, glowing tone! This scrub is made with a fine powder of pumice, and it works wonderfully. I pair it with a lightweight moisturizer afterwards and it’s perfect. A little goes a long way! Def use on damp face, and scrub in circular motions gently and for no longer than 60 seconds otherwise I could see it becoming abrasive. I will definitely buy more when I run out, this stuff is my skins saving grace! 🙏

My face was long overdue for a simple scrub to remove dead skin cells. This product by DRMTLGY has a nice texture, and it isn't overly grainy; leaving the skin with a soft, subtle texture afterwards. The scrub consists of just a couple minutes out of your day, and it opts the user to be comfortable with using up to 2-3 times a week if necessary. It's affordable and worth a try if you're seeking a quick skin resolution. ✨️

avis.titre: Gentle physical exfoliation without drying skin.
avis.texte: Very gentle-enough for everyday use. Smells fresh and slightly of rose/citrus. I wouldn’t consider this overly moisturizing, but it does not strip or cause dry skin either-which is good enough for a greasy skinned gal like me. Definitely keep away from eyes-it doesn’t hurt, but you’ll need to rinse your eyes otherwise it feels like you were caught in a dust storm. I use in the shower after cleansing with regular face wash. I treat with salicylic acid after showering. My skin is smooth and feels clean. I use bare hands-cleansing clothes with it are almost too much; however, a soft bamboo cloth for gentle rinsing works perfect. As long as you don’t scrub excessively, or on already irritated skin it works to smooth without chemical irritation. I use glycolic acid OR this scrub, not both at the same time (usually alternating weeks in winter; summertime I avoid AHA bc it make my skin crazy sensitive to sunlight). This is good for general exfoliation-flakey skin etc. To remove dark spots or serious acne scarring you’d need to find a regimen alternating AHA and this probably, then moisturize with light retinol/sunscreen/peptides. Have not noticed any interactions with OTC face products either.

avis.titre: Great scrub with a gentle texture!
avis.texte: I wanted to try this scrub because my med spa uses one with the same ingredients, and I’m really impressed. The micro texture provides great exfoliation without needing much product, and it works wonderfully on my face and scalp—I just add a little to my shampoo in the shower. My skin hasn’t gotten irritated from using it, and I also appreciate that it doesn’t have any strong smell. The container is small, but a little goes a long way, so it should last me several months.

Feels like a gritty face polish. I have sensitive skin and haven’t had any issues- maybe a little redness right after use but it goes away. I only use about once a week, I expect the container will last me a few months at that rate. I wouldn’t say I’m glowing, but my skin does feel extra clean and smooth after use.

I was looking for a more intense scrub, one that you couldn’t use daily, to really get the flaky spots on my nose and forehead. I landed on this product. It arrived today. I loved that it is made in USA. Appreciated there was a seal keeping the scrub fresh until first use. It has an earthy smell which I liked. The texture was like sand granules. I massaged it on my face and neck, rinsed and immediately felt like a new, deeper clean! I would recommend!

I just opened up my package & all I can say is $20 for 2oz is crazy.. but it’s definitely my fault because I clearly did not read it thoroughly lol smh… but I’m going to try it out and see what it gives for my acne scars, I will update if I can in a few weeks.

I am usually skeptical of skincare products you buy online, but I found this when I was searching for a face scrub that wouldn’t irritate my skin. I really like that the pumice stone granules are SUPER fine, and also that it’s natural stone and not micro plastic that will end up in the ocean. It is great at scrubbing dead skin off my face a couple times a week and it should really last me quite a while, probably at least 6 months. I’d buy this again, and also I might check out other products from this brand.

I was skeptical, because I’m very picky about facial scrubs, but this one is so finely milled. It almost feels like it’s buffing your skin. I absolutely love it and will continue to buy it. The jar is extremely small but last forever.

DRMTLGY Microdermabrasion Scrub FAR exceeded my expectations. I have tried some similarly categorized products that were much more expensive and didn’t work nearly as well! The “grit”, if you will, is very fine in this product which feels much better during application. Unlike products made with sugar or salt, this pumice based product retains its consistency allowing you to scrub as little or as much as you’d like. The best part? My face was as soft as a baby’s behind when I was done! I love this product and it will be a staple in my routine!

I really love this microdermabrasion scrub. It worked wonderfully. I was skeptical about how effective it would he because it's so cheap in price. But nothing cheap about the quality. The other microderm scrub I've used was Dr brandt. (Only because I received a full size bottle from my Ipsy bag) and I feel my face got the very same treatment. Only I had to use a little more product than the pea size dab from Dr Brandt. But who cares. $100 vs. $15 = same results... can't beat that! THANK YOU DRMTLGY!

I was excited to try this new face scrub by DRMTLGY. Then I opened the jar and it wasn't full of product. I was really disappointed. I guess it's true, you have to be careful on what you buy, but I'm still going to try it.

avis.titre: Perfect specifications and qualities for face exfoliation
avis.texte: I was very pleasantly surprised by this product. First, it was sealed properly, which tells me that they take sanitation that is important to the health of the skin seriously. They do not have a leaflet of instructions but they are printed on the outer box and the bottle, itself, and are very easy to follow. I also appreciate that it has only minimal, i.e. ideal, scrubbing properties for the face, so it worked well without incurring skin damage. I love the feel and smell, and I think it is a great product designed specifically to treat the face and exfoliate it efficiently with its smaller scrubs, and I definitely recommend it

I’ve wanted this for so long & I finally found it in stock I’m so happy I was so excited to try it & it’s really good at exfoliating your skin & getting all the dead skin off. It feels gritty but no to abrasive it’s the perfect combination of gentle yet effective I love this stuff.

I am always on the hunt for an excellent exfoliator. I believe that proper exfoliation every day is the answer to smooth skin small pores and a glowing complexion. I’m 68 years old and people tell me I look 20 years younger than I am. I thought I would try this really because of the price and I am astounded it is one of the best exfoliators I have ever used. It is gentle it is efficient it makes my skin like A babies bottom. I will be re-buying it and you need so very little excellent product

I forgot to check reviews before purchasing so the fact that it came half full was a bit of a surprise. I'm not sure if that's due to manhandling or the product itself tho. It has a very faint smell that's pleasant and not too strong. Lastly, I know people have said that it's gentle and the grains are small but I actually thought they were a lot rougher than what I was used to. It still gets the dead skin cells off tho, so can't complain. Will have to use it a bit longer to see if there are any results and if I'll purchase again, but so far so good.

Really amazing stuff here! A little goes a long way! Really fine polishing material, so it really works. Be gentle as with any microdermabrasion scrubs you can cause micro tearing of your skin. It truly will make your skin feel soft and amazing if you use it correctly. I recommend using a moisturizing mask and a good moisturizer after to help from drying out. Not from this product just in general as a whole skincare routine. A must try!

Opened the product and it was sealed. Peeled the seal and saw that a good portion of the product was not there due to the air pocket. This is irritating because since it is already a small product, to then have less product in the container is disappointing to say the least. Like a bag of lays chips. I have yet to try the product. If the product is good then I will edit this.

My skin was feeling so dull and dry. I’m in my mid 50s. I started searching Amazon for a microdermabrasion mask. This is a fabulous product! Photo was taken right after I rinsed off the product. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I ordered this back in September. It's a creamy texture with pumice. Comes in a very light blue tint. The ingredients are sugar cane, lemon fruit,apple fruit and green tea extract. I use this for dead skin after my tretinoin. I know you're not supposed to use any other exfoliating products while on prescribed topicals but my chin is usually flaky. The microdermabrasion helps with this. So YAY. Thanks.

Great for exfoliating without feeling like your skin is getting shredded. It says on the bottle it can be used 2 to 3 times a week. It doesn't really have a smeel, just smells "clean". It's a very think cream and I would imagine it would last for months using it once or twice a week.
Small granules, use with a bit of water to lesson the abrasive feel on your face, gentle enough to use several times a week! Leaves skin smooth. Happy w my purchase

Facinada con este producto, Desde el primer uso note la diferencia en mi piel, limpia, e hydrata muy bien. Mis poros estan disminuyendo y las manchas por el acne estan desapareciendo,Tengo dos semanas usandolo 3 veces por semana y ya noto bastante la diferencia. Recomiendo que despues de usarlo usen algun tipo de suero para un rostro glamuroso..

avis.titre: Does what it's meant to do
avis.texte: I have dry skin and this product is perfect. Love that it's also anti aging. I only use a teaspoon and it goes on my face and neck. My skin doesn't feel dry after each use. It does leave a tinny residue but it goes away. There's barely any scent to this product.

avis.titre: Ingredient list attached! Works well, a little less scary than chemical peels
avis.texte: I use creams with retinol, glycolic acid, and other exfoliators (not simultaneously) as well as face cleansers of the same type. I'm actually 67 y/o and no one ever believes it. This scrub is good because used no more than once or twice a week, it does what the others do but I feel that I have more control over it.

Upon opening my package there was that notorious hole in the product that I read several reviews about. I did tap it down to see how full/empty the container really is. It’s not that bad. I took a before and after picture of both. Typical sized face moisturizer jar side by side for size reference. Now the product itself. The grains for scrubbing are very small, but have A LOT of scrubbing power. I’m not sure if you have sensitive skin these will work for you. I only felt the product in my fingers. Once I use it to scrub my face I’ll update the review. I do have somewhat sensitive skin being an “older” woman of 50. I bought this to try in replacement of my Pur microdermabrasion scrub, which has been by far my favorite of all time. If you’ve used that before, I will tell you that the scrubbing beads (?) are much more course in this product than the Pur. Will update further later.
I'm very glad with this product. I've been suffering for hormonal acne and clogged pores for a while and this scrub since to work magic on my skin.

It doesn’t moisturize or have a scent but exfoliates very gently. It has become a regular in my regime and I can tell when I forget to use it. Have another one on the way because as you can see I Am almost out!

The product is great but just know there is a chance you are going to miss out on quite a bit of product. I’m guessing there was an air bubble. When you pay for a product no matter what the cost you expect the entire product not only about 60% of it.

I really enjoy this brand. I have started using the micro-derma raison scrub that is gentle, non-abrasive and cruelty free! I have no complaints. Since I’m a shop-a-holic—-‘I can thoroughly approve of this product lol. I’ve been using it a few weeks now. ❤️

container came cracked as it was freely tossed into a shipping box with other stuff. it exfoliates well but is drying. fragrance is too strong, like a nivea cream in a can or something cheap like that.

I use this Scrub along with the Revitalift Moisturizer and Serum by L’Oréal along And all together is very amazing ! This scrub has my face feeling super smooth and refresh ! I will definitely be purchasing this scrub again !

Honestly i just received the product. But i will say im a little nervous due to the packaging. It always makes me nervous to use a product that has a shifty label. I will try this product because of the reviews and will post an update at a later time.
While I reach like how this product makes my skin, the amount of product is surprisingly not a lot. It was my 2nd time using this product and a little Shifting in my drawer Unveiled a massive bubble.

I am very disappointed with the amount of product in the bottle, I just think it’s very dishonest to sell someone an item with container that’s already small half empty. However the product is good my skin is smooth soft and it works well removing dead skin

When I opened the package, I noticed it was wet even though the plastic seal areound the jar was intact. Upon further inspection the lid wasn't screwed on correctly and the seal under the lid was definitely opened. As you can see, the product inside the tub is definitely not how it's supposed to look. It's blue and there are large clear crystals in it. I am not sure what this is. I will be returning it.

First of all I was so exited to receive this product but upon opening the jar I was VERY disappointed to see that the jar was not full with a gaping hole in it for the price they I paid. The jar is very small with begin with and to pay full price of $20 is unacceptable. I either want a replacement or want a full refund.

The item was delivered this evening as expected. When I opened it, it looked like it shown in the photo. Before I ordered it, I had read other customers’ reviews and pictures of similar problem. I was hoping my order would come in better shape. I’m disgusted with what I found upon opening it. You can be sure that I will not buy this product again!

I haven’t try the product yet, I just received it and noticed the jar was lightweight until I opened it then I noticed it was half way full meaning instead of 2oz I got 1 oz, dont think this product will last me long as stated on the ad. I will update my review after first and second use.
Use this daily; definitely improved skin radiance; only a little goes a long way; not too harsh like some exfoliation products; pleasant smell, rinses easily; will buy again.

avis.titre: Product skimping, or jar too big for 2 oz. ?
avis.texte: It feels like I'm not getting my money's worth when I open it and see the jar half empty. I haven't tried the product yet, but the packaging has me disappointed.

avis.titre: Hard to rinse off and not full!
avis.texte: Underwhelmed by this product. It arrived under filled and it’s very difficult to rinse off thoroughly. Extremely gritty texture leaves sand like particles in eyelashes during the rinse process.
I have semi sensitive skin and this did not irritate me whatsoever (I breakout with any st Ives product even “sensitive”). It’s been one month and my skin feels great!
I love mine! It comes in handy with dry skin & it’s not to abrasive :)

avis.titre: The fine granules make a difference!
avis.texte: Shipping was fast and the product was well packaged and sealed. However, I question the true amount of product in the jar, After opening, I found the contents to look like someone had taken a huge chunk out of it already. I understand that shifting can occur during shipping, but this really seems a bit extreme. I took a couple of photos. The compete jar with contents weighed 3.2 ounces. So if there are truly 2.0 ounces of product like advertised, the container weighs just 1.2 ounces, I am really curious if this is typical? Other than what I wrote above, I love the scrub! The smell is clean and fresh, not too strong or anything. The small fine granules feel nice and gentle on my skin. I really feel like a little goes a long way, which is great since there is such a small quantity. After rinsing off, my skin feels so smooth and clean. As long as I moisturize my skin, I do not notice any drying or irritation. .
Great product. My skin is soft and glowing! It even feels good using it.
I just received the product and when I opened the microdermabrasion scrub, the cover was already opened..I need a replacement. Thanks

I’ve tried so many exfoliating scrubs over the years, and this is the only one that has actually made a noticeable difference. After just a few uses, my skin texture looked smoother and more even, and my face feels unbelievably soft. The best surprise is that it doesn’t leave my skin feeling stripped or dry—it actually feels hydrated afterward. This has officially become a staple in my skincare routine! I honestly cannot brag on this product enough!
I should have read the reviews unfortunately this left my skin red and burning where I had to put ice on my skin 😡

I just received this and it looks like the jar is only half full. Pictures posted by others show a full container, so I feel a little ripped off. I've seen that others have also received jars like this. Even if the product is great, this seems dishonest.
Just received this product and a decent chunk of it seems to be missing. Slightly disappointing.

avis.titre: It will scratch your face up
avis.texte: I did not like this product. I followed easy instructions but it scratched my entire face up and now I have to allow it to heal.

avis.titre: Will irritate skin (dry) and burning sensation
avis.texte: Absolutely dissatisfied with the product. Don’t know how long it will take to heal from this but it’s uncomfortable at the moment. Would not recommend👎🏼
Used at night and morning my skin just filled with bumps and acne. Do not recommend if u have ane prone skin and sensitive
I received this item today. When I opened it, I got so disappointed. The the jar is only half way full. A 2oz jar and I only got 1 oz of product. Beware.

avis.titre: I will not buy it again
avis.texte: I was so excited to open it. Just to find out it is almost half empty. I will not buy it again.

Just received this product in the mail and so disappointed! First of all the product wasn’t sealed. It looks like it was at some point but someone opened it and scooped out majority of the product! What a scam! Don’t waste your money or your time ordering this product.
Disappointed when I open not full at all Cream was ok not impressed it.

avis.titre: It did burn my skin badly
avis.texte: Picture speaks for itself , this is what this product did to my skin and I’m not considered sensitive skin
I don't think I'll buy this product again. The container is really small for what you're paying and on top of that is not even full as you can see on the picture. To me, is not worth it!
I did not even get a chance to use the product. It arrived and it was basically half empty.

So far I've used this scrub twice . I just turned 44 so .....as I notice my skin changing, im always into buying tons of different products to see what I like. especially , since I have some mild scarring from acne . for me I've bought some extremely overpriced products hoping they would make a difference but the higher the dollar amount doesn't always mean the more flawless skin you'll have or the better quality it is. It definitely has more grit than most, but you can't tell until you actually apply it . when you open the jar its a whipped looking consistency so it doesn't look like it would have a grit to it but its the perfect texture. Its not to gritty but its enough to wear its a good one to use a few times a week. I'm on my fourth day of having a chemical peel so this scrub helped getting the last stubborn dead, flakey skin off. So far its a good scrub I have tried better but we will see as time goes .
Came half empty. It was box packed but upon opening it was half empty. See attached pic. Feeling cheated.

I use this 2 to 3 times a week in the shower. It has lasted a long time and is only half gone! I love how gentle it is on my skin, and how well it cleans off dead skin and smooths out dry spots. It's way better for your skin than cheap competitors like apricot scrub that can damage your skin. It has helped clear my skin, and has given me a healthier complexion. I highly recommend this brand!

I have never used this one before, but it’s definitely a grainy scrub. I do like how it feels after but putting it on. You can definitely feel the scrub part. I do wish they had filled the bottle just a little bit more. There’s a lot of open space in that bottle.

This scrub is AmaZzing! You don’t need a lot of it to work. To those who THINK they are being cheated of product. Have you ever heard of settling? That my ratio protein yogurt it comes in a box. Things settle but it all there.

The scrub works and is fairly gentle on my skin. I had an acne spot and after using I was able to pop it and it removed nicely and the remaining spot is much less visible than usual. I would say that it did help a bit with acne scarring, but I’ve only used it twice so far. Pros: It worked, my skin is smooth when before it wasn’t. It is fairly gentle. The container is small and compact which is great for traveling. It is easy to wash off so it’s a quick process. Cons: I did notice redness after using, by my skin is naturally red and it could have been from scrubbing in general. It is very drying, I had to put a bit more moisturizer on after than I usually use, however it has absorbed nicely and isn’t continuing to be dry. It smells like chemicals.

Not sure what's up with the negative reviews but I love this stuff . My skin was amazingly soft after the first use , pores clearer so I expect after a few uses my skin will be even better . The jar was also full to the top . I will def buy this again .

I absolutely love this product! It transforms my skin and it prepares it for makeup so well. My makeup glides on and it's so clean. I apply it on my face and work the product in small circles for a minute or two and then use a wash cloth to take it off with warm water. Then I spray my face with cold Evian spray mist, then toner, moisturizer and I'm ready to go! This product is excellent. Go for it!
very fine grit, good for gentle exfoliation 2x a week- a little goes a long way

avis.titre: One week and see a positive difference
avis.texte: I have a before and after pictures I’m not sure what this is not whiteheads because they wouldn’t pop. But one week of using this and you see the difference. Also, I have a gluten allergy and this is gluten free. Definitely recommend this

Stay away if u have sensitive skin like I do! I applied it and then went in the shower to take it off and it left my face red. It feel like a sunburn. I really hope this wears off by the morning when I have to go to work 😩

avis.titre: Why is there a huge scoop amount gone?
avis.texte: Ummm... it's a 1/4 empty. I saw other reviews that had the same issues but thought it might be a fluke. Guess not. This is very disappointing 😞.
